insights: **Weekly Highlights —** MAC Energy delivered $87,856 in total sales for Week 45, up 3.4% from $84,933 the prior week, on 3570 units. Organic revenue jumped 32.8% to $47,873, led by the 4-in-1 Variety Pack at $39,179 (+2.7%) and a strong lift from Proper Punch at $10,608 (+14.3%). Monday, Nov 2 was the peak day at $13,918.

**Metrics to Watch —** Orange Creamsicle eased to $9,981 (-9.1%) as sessions declined 11.1% to 1819, while its conversion held at 21.6%. Sessions also dipped on the Variety Pack (-6.5%), but its conversion rose to 29.8%, so we are focused on restoring traffic to these listings to keep the organic momentum going.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** We cut ad spend to $37,500 from $59,527 while PPC revenue held at $39,983 (-18.2%), lifting ROAS to 1.07x from 0.82x and bringing TACoS down to 42.7% from 70.09%. ACOS is at 93.8% with a strong 17.95% ad conversion rate on a 0.23% ad CTR, and we will keep pushing efficiency as organic sales carry more of the volume.

**Actions This Week —** We will continue reducing bids on high-ACOS terms and reallocate budget toward the Variety Pack and Proper Punch, which converted at 29.8% and 31.0%. We will also support Orange Creamsicle with targeted campaigns to rebuild sessions, and test new Sponsored Brand and video ad creative to lift ad CTR above 0.23%.
